top_stories.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the risks of deploying autonomous AI agents to interact with critical public infrastructure.

top_stories.title: Python 3.15 released
top_stories.summary: Version 3.15 of the Python programming language has been released. Notable changes in this release include the addition of the sentinel and frozendict built-in types, the use of UTF-8 encoding by default, package start-up configuration files, as well as improvements in the experimental JIT compiler. See the "What's new in Python 3.15" article for an in-depth look at new features in this release, and the changelog for a full list of changes.
top_stories.why_it_matters: Brings new built-in types, default UTF-8 encoding, and performance improvements to Python developers.

top_stories.title: Cloudflare Traces Turns the Proxy Layer into OpenTelemetry Spans, with New Volume-Based Pricing
top_stories.summary: Cloudflare has put Traces into open beta, extending automatic tracing from Workers to security rules, transformations, cache, routing and origin handling as OpenTelemetry spans. Traces accept and forward W3C traceparent headers, and Trace Rules allow targeted sampling. Pricing moves to ingestion and retention volume from December 1. By Steef-Jan Wiggers
top_stories.why_it_matters: Brings native OpenTelemetry support directly to the proxy layer for better observability workflows.
